a1.text: In 2022, only 61 percent of U.S. adults aged 45 to 75 were up to date on colon cancer screening.
a1.caption: In 2022, only 61 percent of U.S. adults aged 45 to 75 were up to date on colon cancer screening.

a2.text: Parents often put their own checkups last. ScreenTalk helps teens start the screening conversation at home.
a2.caption: Parents often put their own checkups last. ScreenTalk helps teens start the screening conversation at home.

a3.text: It follows American Cancer Society guidelines. It's education, not diagnosis, and nothing you type leaves your device.
a3.caption: It follows American Cancer Society guidelines. It's education, not diagnosis, and nothing you type leaves your device.

a4.text: Load a made-up demo family. Mom is 46, so it's time to talk about breast, colon, and cervical cancer screening, each linked to the A C S guideline.
a4.caption: Load a made-up demo family. Mom is 46, so it's time to talk about breast, colon, and cervical cancer screening, each linked to the ACS guideline.

a5.text: Each topic also shows what the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force says, tagged Same as A C S or Differs from A C S, plus a note on no-copay coverage.
a5.caption: Each topic also shows what the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force says, tagged Same as ACS or Differs from ACS, plus a note on no-copay coverage.

a6.text: Dad is 52 and quit smoking 18 years ago, so his lung card explains where the two guidelines differ, and prostate testing is a choice to discuss.
a6.caption: Dad is 52 and quit smoking 18 years ago, so his lung card explains where the two guidelines differ, and prostate testing is a choice to discuss.

b1.text: Adding someone takes seconds, and the pack-year helper does the math.
b1.caption: Adding someone takes seconds, and the pack-year helper does the math.

b2.text: Because Uncle still smokes, ScreenTalk links free help to quit.
b2.caption: Because Uncle still smokes, ScreenTalk links free help to quit.

b3.text: Each person also gets questions for the checkup, a progress tracker, and a calendar reminder.
b3.caption: Each person also gets questions for the checkup, a progress tracker, and a calendar reminder.

c1.text: Now the hard part: bringing it up. Tap Start the talk with Mom, and ScreenTalk writes an opener that names her exact topics. Casual, heartfelt, or a text. Edit it, then copy it.
c1.caption: Now the hard part: bringing it up. Tap Start the talk with Mom, and ScreenTalk writes an opener that names her exact topics. Casual, heartfelt, or a text. Edit it, then copy it.

c2.text: Parents push back, so you can practice. Mom says, I feel fine. Pick a reply, and the coach explains why it works, with a source.
c2.caption: Parents push back, so you can practice. Mom says, I feel fine. Pick a reply, and the coach explains why it works, with a source.

c3.text: Lecture her about cost, and her openness drops. At the end you get a score, Mom's final answer, and a better line for each round.
c3.caption: Lecture her about cost, and her openness drops. At the end you get a score, Mom's final answer, and a better line for each round.

d1.text: One switch turns the whole app into Spanish.
d1.caption: One switch turns the whole app into Spanish.

d2.text: There's also a Myth or Fact game sourced from N C I and A C S, plus free hotlines and screening programs.
d2.caption: There's also a Myth or Fact game sourced from NCI and ACS, plus free hotlines and screening programs.

d3.text: It's plain JavaScript, with no server and no tracking. 115 unit tests and 246 browser checks keep every guideline boundary honest.
d3.caption: It's plain JavaScript, with no server and no tracking. 115 unit tests and 246 browser checks keep every guideline boundary honest.

d4.text: ScreenTalk. You can't order your parents a colonoscopy, but you can start the conversation.
d4.caption: ScreenTalk. You can't order your parents a colonoscopy, but you can start the conversation.

d1b.text: Load the demo family, and it's Mamá, Papá, Abuela, and Hermana mayor.
d1b.caption: Load the demo family, and it's Mamá, Papá, Abuela, and Hermana mayor.
